sentences.text: A Channel 12 News poll showed the bloc led by former IDF Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot holding at 54 seats, falling short of a 60-seat Knesset majority due to refusal among some allied parties to cooperate with Arab factions.

sources.title: Poll: Eisenkot bloc holds at 54 seats as hard-line ex-general's party falls short
Could these two small parties be Israel’s kingmakers?

sentences.text: Ben-Gvir refused to sign a surplus vote agreement with Ofer Winter's People of Israel party, calling Winter Bennett II and prompting Winter to accuse him of wasting right-wing votes ahead of the election.

sources.title: 'Bennett II': Ben-Gvir refuses to sign vote surplus share agreement with Winter's People of Israel
Ben-Gvir rules out surplus vote agreement with ex-general hardliner's new far-right party

sentences.text: Winter also accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of prioritizing political survival over security by focusing on the electoral threshold rather than reducing trucks entering Gaza.

sources.title: 'Focus on Hamas, not me': Winter accuses Netanyahu of prioritizing political survival over security

sentences.text: According to sources, Haredi parties may refuse to endorse both Netanyahu and Eisenkot, while Avigdor Liberman announced that mandatory universal conscription and an expert-drafted constitution are nonnegotiable conditions for joining a government.

sources.title: Haredi parties may refuse to endorse both Netanyahu, Eisenkot after Israeli election, sources say
Universal conscription, constitution plan: Liberman reveals requirements to form government

sentences.text: Naftali Bennett unveiled a plan for the B'Yachad party aimed at cutting bureaucracy and increasing support for immigrants.

sources.title: Naftali Bennett unveils B’Yachad party plan to cut bureaucracy, boost support for olim - interview

sentences.text: Additionally, United States President Donald Trump stated that he may endorse a candidate in Israel's upcoming election.

sources.title: Trump says he 'may' endorse a candidate in Israel's upcoming election
